Tipping Co's agent sends no client_id at the token endpoint, only client_assertion_type and client_assertion (company.ts tokenRequest). RFC 7521 4.2 makes client_id optional beside a client assertion, since the assertion's iss and sub name the client; the draft never requires it, but every token request in its examples carries one. Every third-party Company in the grid but its own requires it (poppyseed: 'client_id is required'; pi-poppy fetches an undefined client_id; adonis-agora: 'private_key_jwt client authentication is required'), so the first Session fails with invalid_client. Our mocks accept it since 13 October, so lenient-company passes; at strict-company and poppy-demo the missing typ is blamed first, a reading (S2). Unattributed or blamed on the agent by the grid rule elsewhere, and on the Company for R at print-with-poppy and adonis-agora, where no other agent can judge rotation. Not an adapter choice: the adapter drives CompanyClient as it is.

Reading S1, blamed on the spec: Tipping Co checks every client assertion's aud against its token endpoint, at /oauth/revoke too (token.ts authenticateClient, revoke.ts), and answers 401 invalid_client to an assertion whose aud is the revocation endpoint. Both Datalayer agents and pi-poppy send the endpoint called (S1 endpoint); pda did too, and since 13 October tries the token endpoint after that invalid_client and passes; adonis-agora and Tipping Co's own agent send the token endpoint and pass. The first signed-in Company in the grid with this reading.

pi-poppy retries a token request after use_dpop_nonce only when WWW-Authenticate names it (agent.ts, the token request's send()). RFC 9449 8 has an authorization server answer 400 with the error in the JSON body and a DPoP-Nonce header, which is what Tipping Co sends; WWW-Authenticate is the resource server's (RFC 9449 9). The Companies that add WWW-Authenticate at the token endpoint too (our mocks, Datalayer) hid this, so there pi-poppy retries and fails differently (the N entry for every Company).
